|gr1= Camera Control

|descr= Set / clear using of night vision during cutscenes. This command only works with [[camCreate]] created camera that is currently the main camera for the player (see {{Link|#Examples}}).

|s1= [[camUseNVG]] set

|p1= set: [[Boolean]] - enable/disable night vision

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>camUseNVG true;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
setDate [2000, 12, 31, 0, 0];
_cam = "camera" camCreate [0, 0, 0];
_cam camSetTarget player;
_cam camSetRelPos [0, -5, 3];
_cam cameraEffect ["Internal", "Back"];
_cam camCommit 0;
camUseNVG true;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[setCamUseTI]] [[disableTIEquipment]]
